User Access Control Documentation

Welcome to the documentation of the User Access Control project.

This project is developed using Python and FastAPI. It provides a secure authentication and authorization system that allows users to log in and access only the pages permitted to them.

Project Features

  • User login and logout

  • Password hashing using bcrypt

  • Session-based authentication

  • User-specific page permissions

  • Protected routes using FastAPI

  • MySQL database integration

  • Access denied page for unauthorized users

Technology Stack

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • MySQL

  • PyMySQL

  • Starlette SessionMiddleware

  • bcrypt

  • HTML and CSS
